summary: water colors turned to poems remixed into jazz melodies converted to a zine cut up and those lucky enough find a #clmooc postcard doodle or poem inscribed for we make no distinction between physical and digital #justfriends
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
water colors
turned to poems
remixed into jazz melodies
converted to a zine
cut up
and those lucky enough
find a #clmooc postcard
doodle or poem
inscribed
for we make no
distinction between
physical and digital
#justfriends
